products.name: EX Trainer Kit 2: Plusle & Minun
products.note: Two half decks, Plusle and Minun, each with one cosmos-holofoil Pokémon (Plusle 6, Minun 6), plus rule books, a playmat, damage and status counters and a coin, and one booster pack of an EX-series set that no source names. The pack is not simulated, and the copies of each card a half deck held are not on record, so opening the kit from either half-deck page deals one of each different card of both decks.
products.priceSource: The kit's own TCGplayer listing (product 98951) has no price; priced at its 24 different cards' market prices added up, one of each (a floor: the real decks held more copies, and the booster pack is not counted).
